kernel_settings.backward_scope: new forward plus all input gradients, excluding fixture preparation and finite checks
kernel_settings.forward_scope: training forward including autograd context; no backward
kernel_settings.gdn: upstream standard tied sigmoid write/erase, native BF16 intermediates
kernel_settings.softmax_query_transform: BF16(unit query multiplied by key width), outside timing

limitations: Upstream standard GDN ties sigmoid write and erase gates; it is not the signed independent-gate model.
Native upstream BF16 intermediates differ from the local JAX GDN's FP32/TF32x3 intermediates.
Device-resident compute timings exclude data loading, validation, and checkpointing.
CUDA event timing and synchronized wall timing include the operator's normal upstream dispatch.

cuda_graph.scope: CUDA graph replay; capture, autotuning, and finite checks excluded
